## Description

The owner types a question ("revenue by doctor last month"). The AI service turns it into a read-only query on the reporting store (P4-029), runs it and shows the answer with the query used.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Queries run only against the reporting store, read-only, with a row and time limit.
- [ ] **AC2.** The answer shows the query, and is labelled as an AI draft.
- [ ] **AC3.** No patient-identifying column is reachable.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
